expertText:
* = $0801
.region Consts
.const line_total = 30
.const rand_state_lo = $C100
.const rand_state_hi = $C101
.const line_count = $C102
.const x1_hi = $C103
.const x2_hi = $C104
.const cx_hi = $C105
.const dx_hi = $C106
.endregion
.region Main
; ================================================
; C64 HIRES BITMAP - BRESENHAM LINE DRAWING DEMO
; ================================================
start:
; Screen RAM $0400-$07E7: fill $10 (fg=white, bg=black)
    LDA $D011
    AND #$EF
; display off
    STA $D011
    LDA #$10
    LDX #$00
scr_fill:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE scr_fill
scr_last:
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE scr_last
; Bitmap clear: $2000-$3F3F (8000 bytes)
    LDA #$20
    STA $FE
    LDA #$00
    STA $FD
    LDX #$1F
    LDY #$00
bmp_clr:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    BNE bmp_clr
    INC $FE
    DEX
    BNE bmp_clr
    LDY #$00
bmp_clr2:
    STA ($FD),Y
    INY
    CPY #$40
    BNE bmp_clr2
; Hires bitmap mode on
    LDA #$3B
    STA $D011
    LDA #$18
    STA $D018
; Visual proof that code is running
    LDA #$02
    STA $D020
    LDA #$00
    STA $D021
; Seed random state from raster and CIA timers
    LDA $D012
    EOR $DC04
    STA rand_state_lo
    LDA $D011
    EOR $DC05
    STA rand_state_hi
    LDA rand_state_lo
    ORA rand_state_hi
    BNE seed_ok
    LDA #$A5
    STA rand_state_lo
    LDA #$5A
    STA rand_state_hi
seed_ok:
    SEI
; Draw line_total random lines
    LDA #line_total
    STA line_count
draw_random_lines:
    JSR random_point
drl_new_end:
    JSR random_x
    STA $22
    STX x2_hi
    JSR random_y
    STA $23
    LDA $20
    CMP $22
    BNE drl_chk_y
    LDA x1_hi
    CMP x2_hi
    BEQ drl_new_end
drl_chk_y:
    LDA $21
    CMP $23
    BEQ drl_new_end
; Enforce minimum |dx| >= 32 (16-bit; X range is now 0..319)
    LDA $22
    SEC
    SBC $20
    STA $05
    LDA x2_hi
    SBC x1_hi
    STA $06
    BPL drl_dx_abs
    LDA $05
    EOR #$FF
    STA $05
    LDA $06
    EOR #$FF
    STA $06
    CLC
    LDA $05
    ADC #$01
    STA $05
    LDA $06
    ADC #$00
    STA $06
drl_dx_abs:
    LDA $06
    BNE drl_dy_check
    LDA $05
    CMP #$20
    BCC drl_new_end
; Enforce minimum |dy| >= 16 for clearly visible slope variation
drl_dy_check:
    LDA $23
    SEC
    SBC $21
    BCS drl_dy_abs
    EOR #$FF
    CLC
    ADC #$01
drl_dy_abs:
    CMP #$10
    BCC drl_new_end
drl_draw:
    JSR drawline
    DEC line_count
    BNE draw_random_lines
    CLI
    JSR wait_key
    JSR restore_text_mode
    RTS
random_byte:
; 16-bit Galois LFSR (poly x^16+x^14+x^13+x^11+1, xor mask $B400)
    LDA rand_state_hi
    LSR
    STA rand_state_hi
    LDA rand_state_lo
    ROR
    STA rand_state_lo
    BCC rb_no_xor
    LDA rand_state_hi
    EOR #$B4
    STA rand_state_hi
rb_no_xor:
; Mix hi/lo to reduce visible correlation between consecutive coords
    LDA rand_state_lo
    EOR rand_state_hi
    RTS
random_y:
    JSR random_byte
    CMP #200
    BCS random_y
    RTS
random_x:
; Returns X low byte in A, high bit (0/1) in X, constrained to 0..319
rx_loop:
    JSR random_byte
    PHA
    JSR random_byte
    AND #$01
    TAX
    PLA
    CPX #$00
    BEQ rx_ok
    CMP #$40
    BCS rx_loop
rx_ok:
    RTS
random_point:
; Returns X in $20/x1_hi and Y in $21, and keeps X low in A
    JSR random_x
    STA $20
    STX x1_hi
    JSR random_y
    STA $21
    LDA $20
    RTS
wait_key:
; Flush leftover keys (e.g. RUN/ENTER), then wait for a fresh keypress
wk_flush:
    JSR $FFE4
    CMP #$00
    BNE wk_flush
wk_loop:
    JSR $FFE4
    CMP #$00
    BEQ wk_loop
    RTS
restore_text_mode:
; Back to standard text screen: BMM off, screen at $0400, charset at $1000
    LDA #$1B
    STA $D011
    LDA #$14
    STA $D018
    LDA #$0E
    STA $D020
    LDA #$06
    STA $D021
    LDA #$93
    JSR $FFD2
    RTS
.endregion
.region DrawLine
; ================================================
; DRAWLINE - Bresenham
; In: $20=X1lo x1_hi=X1hi $21=Y1  $22=X2lo x2_hi=X2hi $23=Y2
; ================================================
drawline:
    LDA $20
    STA $FB
    LDA x1_hi
    STA cx_hi
    LDA $21
    STA $FC
; |dx| (16-bit), sx
    LDA x2_hi
    CMP x1_hi
    BCC dl_xneg
    BNE dl_xpos
    LDA $22
    CMP $20
    BCC dl_xneg
dl_xpos:
    SEC
    LDA $22
    SBC $20
    STA $24
    LDA x2_hi
    SBC x1_hi
    STA dx_hi
    LDA #$01
    STA $26
    JMP dl_caldy
dl_xneg:
    SEC
    LDA $20
    SBC $22
    STA $24
    LDA x1_hi
    SBC x2_hi
    STA dx_hi
    LDA #$FF
    STA $26
; |dy|, sy
dl_caldy:
    LDA $23
    CMP $21
    BCS dl_ypos
    SEC
    LDA $21
    SBC $23
    STA $25
    LDA #$FF
    STA $27
    JMP dl_init
dl_ypos:
    SEC
    LDA $23
    SBC $21
    STA $25
    LDA #$01
    STA $27
; err = dx - dy (16-bit signed)
dl_init:
    SEC
    LDA $24
    SBC $25
    STA $28
    LDA dx_hi
    SBC #$00
    STA $29
dl_loop:
    JSR setpixel
    LDA $FB
    CMP $22
    BNE dl_step
    LDA cx_hi
    CMP x2_hi
    BNE dl_step
    LDA $FC
    CMP $23
    BEQ dl_done
dl_step:
; e2 = err * 2 (16-bit) -- use safe ZP; $2A/$2B would corrupt BASIC pointers
    LDA $28
    ASL $000A
    STA $05
    LDA $29
    ROL $000A
    STA $06
; if (e2 + dy) > 0: err -= dy, CX += sx
    CLC
    LDA $05
    ADC $25
    TAX
    LDA $06
    ADC #$00
    BPL dl_xchk
    JMP dl_ychk
dl_xchk:
    BNE dl_do_x
    CPX #$00
    BEQ dl_ychk
dl_do_x:
    SEC
    LDA $28
    SBC $25
    STA $28
    LDA $29
    SBC #$00
    STA $29
    LDA $26
    BMI dl_dec_x
dl_inc_x:
    INC $FB
    BNE dl_ychk
    INC cx_hi
    JMP dl_ychk
dl_dec_x:
    LDA $FB
    BNE dl_dec_x_lo
    DEC cx_hi
dl_dec_x_lo:
    DEC $FB
; if e2 < dx: err += dx, CY += sy
dl_ychk:
    LDA $06
    BMI dl_do_y
    CMP dx_hi
    BCC dl_do_y
    BNE dl_loop
    LDA $05
    CMP $24
    BCC dl_do_y
    JMP dl_loop
dl_do_y:
    CLC
    LDA $28
    ADC $24
    STA $28
    LDA $29
    ADC dx_hi
    STA $29
    CLC
    LDA $FC
    ADC $27
    STA $FC
    JMP dl_loop
dl_done:
    RTS
.endregion
.region SetPixel
; ================================================
; SETPIXEL - hires pixel plot
; In: $FB=X low, cx_hi=X high bit (0/1), $FC=Y (0-199)
; ================================================
setpixel:
    TXA
    PHA
; addr = $2000 + (Y>>3)*320 + (X>>3)<<3 + (Y&7)
    LDA $FC
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    TAX
    LDA row320lo,X
    STA $FD
    LDA row320hi,X
    STA $FE
; xByte = (X>>3), 0..39
    LDA $FB
    LSR
    LSR
    LSR
    STA $05
    LDA cx_hi
    BEQ sp_xbyte_ok
    LDA $05
    CLC
    ADC #$20
    STA $05
sp_xbyte_ok:
; Add (xByte * 8) as a full 16-bit offset so columns 32..39 work.
    LDA #$00
    STA $06
    LDA $05
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    ASL
    ROL $06
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    LDA $06
    ADC $FE
    STA $FE
sp1:
    CLC
    LDA $FE
    ADC #$20
    STA $FE
    LDA $FC
    AND #$07
    CLC
    ADC $FD
    STA $FD
    BCC sp2
    INC $FE
sp2:
    LDA $FB
    AND #$07
    TAX
    LDA bitmask,X
    LDY #$00
    ORA ($FD),Y
    STA ($FD),Y
    PLA
    TAX
    RTS
.endregion
.region Tables
row320lo:
.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0
.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0
.byte $00, $40, $80, $C0, $00, $40, $80, $C0
.byte $00
row320hi:
.byte $00, $01, $02, $03, $05, $06, $07, $08
.byte $0A, $0B, $0C, $0D, $0F, $10, $11, $12
.byte $14, $15, $16, $17, $19, $1A, $1B, $1C
.byte $1E
bitmask:
.byte $80, $40, $20, $10, $08, $04, $02, $01
.endregion
